insight.headline: New fields for cash
insight.what_changed: New fields are now available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities. The CashDrawerBalance field and cashCountActivities connection are now available. This change allows for more accurate and detailed cash management.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the GraphQL Admin API can now access more detailed information about cash management activities. To take advantage of this change, update your API version to 2026-10 or later and query the new fields. Be sure to handle any potential errors or null values. This change is additive, so no migration is required for existing apps. However, it's recommended to review and update your app's cash management logic to utilize the new fields.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will have more accurate and detailed information about their cash management activities, allowing for better financial tracking and decision-making.
insight.why_it_matters: This change provides more detailed information about cash management activities, allowing developers to build more accurate and informative apps for merchants. It's an important update for apps that handle cash management or point-of-sale functionality.
insight.code_example: query { cashManagement { cashDrawerBalance cashCountActivities { edges { node { id balance } } } } }

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance storefronts, fulfillment, and development tools

themes.title: Storefront Enhancements
themes.detail: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, and WebMCP tools are exposed for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, enabling AI agents to interact with the store. Additionally, Oxygen is now available on development stores for Hydrogen storefront deployment.

themes.title: Fulfillment and Order Management
themes.detail: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, and Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps have been updated to better reflect real-world operations.
